_comment: Config for CI only. src/config.json is gitignored because it holds the
oracle signing key, so a checkout has no config at all -- and the app
imports it at module load, which means `node dist/index.js` exits before
it binds a port. Both server-dependent CI jobs failed on that: one with
ECONNREFUSED, one with a readiness timeout. Neither said 'config missing',
which is why this file exists rather than a line in the workflow.
chainId is 1 because the fixture holds mainnet data and because
lib/chain.js resolves contract addresses from the artifacts by chain id --
on chain 4 it throws for want of an address. The key is a valid but
worthless 32-byte value: ethers.Wallet rejects the example's 0x1234, and
the chain listener is off in CI so nothing signs with it.
